// RSF Layer Forward Pass (szegedi implementáció)
pub fn forward(self: RSFLayer, x1: Tensor, x2: Tensor) !void {
    // Spectral Transform
    var sx2t = try self.sweight.matmul(x2.transpose(), allocator);
    var sx2 = try sx2t.transpose();  // s(x₂) ⊕ bias_s
    
    // S-activation: exp(clipped values)
    try sx2.clip(self.clipmin, self.clipmax);
    try sx2.exp();
    try x1.mul(sx2);  // x₁ ← x₁ ⊙ exp(s(x₂))
    
    // Temporal Transform
    var ty1t = try self.tweight.matmul(x1.transpose(), allocator);
    var ty1 = try ty1t.transpose();  // t(x₁) ⊕ bias_t
    
    // T-activation: linear addition
    try x2.add(ty1);  // x₂ ← x₂ + t(x₁)
}

pub fn inverse(self: RSFLayer, y1: Tensor, y2: Tensor) !void {
    // REVERSE ORDER for invertibility guarantee
    // 1. Inverse temporal: y₂ - t(x₁) → x₂
    // 2. Inverse spectral: y₁ / exp(s(x₂)) → x₁
    
    // This ensures: forward(inverse(y)) = y (mathematical property)
}

    var ty1 = try ty1t.transpose();  // t(x₁) ⊕ bias_t
